[SIBAWAYH:فالمبتدأكلاسمابتدىليبنىعليهكلام|والمبتدأوالمبنىعليهرفع|#261/r4] SIBAWAYH, d. 180 · author | holds | Predicate-first adjective phrases are good Arabic when intentionally fronted; if intended as a verb-like assertion, the nominal form is disfavored.
